We love animals and are always looking for opportunities to meet furry, feathered and finned friends on our trips.  I love exploring new cultures, learning new languages and making new friends.

I look forward to hosting you here in Taipei.

host_about:
Hi, I'm Joe, a travel addict, I used to work and travel at Australia and been to Idia, Cambodia ...... Traveling is such a wonderful thing for me, that is a good way to meet people from different country、culture, we share our life experience or ideas ...... That give me some idea to imagine how the world is, to think about the possibility for life, I believe air b & b is a nice place to help us meet each other, wish we can have a good time!

I do enjoy reading、watching movie, and sometimes play music, like to try something new and experience something new, my job is kind of travel agency, help traveler arrange their trip and meet local around Taiwan! If you have a plan to travel Taiwan for a while, we can share some experience for that!

Let's  in love with Taiwan

嗨! 我是Joe，在去過柬埔寨、印度以及經歷一年的澳洲打工旅遊之後，染上了旅行的癮，旅行對我來說是一件太美好的事情，跟不同國家的人交流，認識不同的文化並且去分享彼此生活，增添了我對世界的想像，並從中看見生活上更多的可能性，air b&b是一個很棒的平台，讓各地的旅者都可以很直接的去接觸當地人，我相信這樣子的方式可以讓不同文化的人有更多的瞭解認識、以及包容，期待我們可以在彼此的生活中留下美好的回憶！

我非常愛看書，看電影，然後偶爾有空會玩玩樂器，喜歡各種新奇的事物，我的工作也跟旅行有關，替各地來台灣旅遊的人規劃行程，並且串連台灣的在地人，帶著旅客從不同面向去感受台灣的美好！如果你剛好也有計畫在台灣旅行，我們可以交流一些想法及意見。

台灣是我最喜歡的國家，讓我們一起愛上這個地方吧！

碩城文旅是一家新興成立的商務旅館，秉持著「精緻、貼心、服務」的經營理念，實踐台灣人的親切包容及軟性實力，積極爭取為全世界旅人服務。
碩城文旅坐落於中山北路一段「條通商圈」的正中心；周邊三條捷運環繞，鄰近南西、華陰商圈，步行可達台北轉運站，交通便利、四通八達，兼具商務及休閒的環境與功能。
中山北路的「條通商圈」，有著日據時代延續至今的異國情調，累積了豐沛的文化特色。華燈初上之時，彎入「條、通」窄窄的巷弄，林立的餐廳、酒館及熱鬧的各式娛樂活動，讓人可以輕鬆度過美好時光。近年來，本館周邊更集結了多家台、日拉麵店，呈現出流行文化與懷舊風情交錯的新魅力。
碩城文旅團隊致力於打造一種屬於都會旅人的休閒文化，洗盡您疲憊的心寧，在舒適的空間及簡潔的設計中，讓您遠離都市喧囂，沈浸在時尚與浪漫的「條通風情」中。
碩城文旅，是您的「家外之家」。不論出差或旅行都是您最好的選擇!

碩城文旅坐落於中山北路一段「條通商圈」的正中心；周邊三條捷運環繞，鄰近南西、華陰商圈，步行可達台北轉運站，交通便利、四通八達，兼具商務及休閒的環境與功能。
中山北路的「條通商圈」，有著日據時代延續至今的異國情調，累積了豐沛的文化特色。華燈初上之時，彎入「條、通」窄窄的巷弄，林立的餐廳、酒館及熱鬧的各式娛樂活動，讓人可以輕鬆度過美好時光。近年來，本館周邊更集結了多家台、日拉麵店，呈現出流行文化與懷舊風情交錯的新魅力。
碩城文旅團隊致力於打造一種屬於都會旅人的休閒文化，洗盡您疲憊的心寧，在舒適的空間及簡潔的設計中，讓您遠離都市喧囂，沈浸在時尚與浪漫的「條通風情」中。
碩城文旅，是您的「家外之家」。不論出差或旅行都是您最好的選擇!

host_about:
HI~我是JOHNNY :

喜歡藝文活動~! 如音樂、藝術、文化、創意、建築、古蹟 …等文青生活
當然我也喜歡旅遊、踏青、爬山、海邊活動
歡迎您來到這溫馨的小旅棧
因為是一般朝九晚六的上班族~!
目前把閒置的房間分享出來當民宿旅棧~!

希望有機會可以一起分享旅行和文化交流
目前雖然尚未有機會完成環遊世界夢想
但是希望有機會先認識世界各地的朋友

平常日因為要上班~
所以深夜休息睡眠時段
ＰＭ００：００～ＡＭ０７：００
沒有辦法提供深夜接待
和自助入住~!

及平日周一～周五
上班時段
ＡＭ０７：００～ＰＭ１９：００
無法接待入住~!

需要等待下班時間ＰＭ１９：００回到家~
打掃完成後
ＰＭ２０：００之後
才方便依照順序
接待遠道而來的您~!

如果提早到達~
請在建議的重要車站站點：
（由台北市西區到東區）
台北車站總站／市政府捷運站／台北１０１捷運站
都有設置投幣式的大型行李寄物櫃
先寄放大型行李~! 
然後建議就近展開旅遊行程～
等待晚上才取行李
然後往公寓移動～！
ＰＭ２０：００之後就可以完成入住囉~!

假日仍然需要等待上組房客退房後
打掃完成~才方便接著接待您~!
沒有房客喜歡被催促退房的～！
（　請不要當冒昧失禮的傲嬌旅客～！）

預訂前
請您詳細閱讀房源相關的
說明／規則／照片／入住時段 / 評價參考
目前沒有開放深夜和自助入住～！
（　如果沒有閱讀而閃訂／瞎訂／誤訂者
而無法在入住時段內到達者
恕不接受接待及退款～！）

如果有確定預訂者
請依照網站的流程
完成訂房程序～！

我的 維信 和 Line  ID :  johnnyspower
有問題可以先加好友聯絡溝通囉～！
（如果沒有閱讀說明／規則／照片／入住時段
就直接冒昧　加 維信 和 Line
我會視您為沒有禮貌的旅客～！）

因為您都不願意花５～１０分鐘
閱讀相關的說明
那我應該沒有義務
花費時間回答您
＠　您基本該做的功課～！
＠　接受重複問題的提問～！
＠　旅行社或導遊方面的問題～！

自助旅行～是愉快美好的事情
請做好基本的功課和禮貌
不要當讓人困擾～和冒昧的不速之客～！

host_about:
Hello from Taiwan!  We are Fun Taiwan Home - contemporary, short-term accommodations in the heart of Taipei, perfect for your next family holiday in Taiwan.  Fun Taiwan Home is affiliated with Fun Taiwan Kids (blog/website) - the ultimate guide to having fun in Taiwan with your kids and Fun Taiwan Camp, an immersive Mandarin learning experience for your kids. 

Hi there - I'm Angie, full-time working mom of 3 and the owner of Fun Taiwan Home.  Fun Taiwan Home is our family's creative project which allows us to delve into two passions - real estate and interior design.   We're a family of 5 who's spent many years abroad and recently returned to Taipei to further kids' mandarin education and our careers.  My husband is Canadian Chinese and I'm Taiwanese American.  As a family, we have lived in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and now resides in Taipei.  

After living in different Asian cities, we are so happy to come home to Taiwan where the food is amazing, people are friendly, and the sights are breathtaking.  The convenient lifestyle, the efficiency, the honesty and the can-do attitude of the Taiwanese people never ceases to amaze me.      

We launched Fun Taiwan Home because we saw a lack of contemporary, comfortable, and family friendly short-term rentals in Taipei.  Our portfolio offers accommodations in the most sought-after, family-friendly neighborhoods of Taipei.  All of the apartments in our portfolio are newly renovated, clean, modern and tastefully designed. Living Repository of Old-Time Flavors. The Culture of the Old City – Bangka.

The old name for the district of Wanhua, still used by many locals, is Bangka (艋舺). In an earlier time, it was one of Taiwan’s three major urban centers. In turn, its prosperity drove the development of the transportation infrastructure. Recalling the days of his youth living on Guangzhou Street, Res-Art remembers the north-south railway running parallel to Zhonghua Road (中華路), and how it divided Guangzhou Street, one side home to many new immigrants who had followed the Nationalist government from mainland China to Taiwan, the other home to those whose ancestors had come from China in imperial times. The railway partitioned what were, in effect, two different peoples, creating two enclaves busy with distinct languages and living customs of different ethnic groups. neighborhood_overview:
2 MRT stations or a 20minutes walk will take you to the bustling Xinyi District, home to Taiwan’s tallest building, Taipei 101.

20minutes walk will also bring you to the Linjiang (Tonghua) Night Market. Additionally, a 20minutes bus ride can get you to Raohe Night Market.

The area is surrounded by numerous restaurants, offering a wide selection for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

Within a 10minutes walk, you can reach seven department stores and shopping malls, including Sogo, Eslite, Shin Kong Mitsukoshi, Ming Yao, and Breeze Center.

Within a 200-meter radius, there are hundreds of bars, nightclubs, and izakayas, ensuring a vibrant nightlife with no shortage of drinks and entertainment.

Convenience stores, drugstores, and pharmacies are all within a five-minute walk.

A five-minute walk will get you to PX Mart and Carrefour for groceries, while a 12-minute walk will take you to the larger grocery store, RT-Mart.

Hello dear guests:
 
Greetings!  We are Alice, Alex, and Arielle from Taipei, Taiwan!  We are a happy married couple met in Southern California when we studied in the States.  We have been together ever since 2005(so 13 years now!) We are best friends, travel buddies and now we are the parents of the most energetic baby girl, Arielle (born October 9th, 2017)!   We also lived and worked in Guangzhou, China for two years.  Our family house is located in Fujin Street (Mingshen Community, one of the best and safest neighborhoods in Taipei, Taiwan) because we truly enjoy living here that we decided to renovate our home and open to friends all over the world!  

We have been Airbnb hosts for over three years now, and we cannot be happier.  We have been Airbnb guests in South Korea, Japan, Brazil, France, Belgium, Czech Republic, and Russia!  We just love hosting and live with Airbnb hosts when we travel to different places!  

We both have jobs during the day, and we try our best to stay fit and healthy so we try to exercise two to three times a week!  Alex loves playing tennis and going to the gym, Alice loves trying different fitness/dance classes!  We enjoy hanging out with family and friends during the weekends.  We love traveling, cycling, watching movies, going out to eat, cooking healthy meals and baking.
We have been traveling as much as we can and we cannot be happier that we can do that!  We love to share our travel stories tips with all our guests!  

We both are very easygoing and caring.  Our baby girl Arielle just checked in since October 2017(and will not check-out our home until 2035?!) but since our house is spacious, you will not be disturbed by baby noises!  We are always here for our guests; we hope you enjoy staying with us and the city of Taipei!  

Hello 親愛的旅人和各地的朋友們

我們是Alice & Alex,一對快樂的夫妻､最好的朋友也是一起走跳世界的旅伴!  我們曾在美國南加州一起念書留學,也曾在中國廣州工作過兩年｡

現在我們定居於台灣台北市的富錦街,一個最安全最適合居住的美麗社區-民生社區!  我們享受也熱衷於美好的生活､一個溫暖舒適的家,因此決定開放了屬於我們的Fujin House 邀請您一起分享民生社區的陽光和綠蔭!

我們加入Airbnb已經有超過三年的時間,除了在台灣當hosts之外,旅行時也經常選擇Airbnb,如韓國､日本､捷克､巴西､法國､俄羅斯等地｡我們不僅熱愛旅行,更真心喜歡這種有人情味､有溫度的旅行方式｡
